entries.text: Join as a community to praise God through contemporary Christian worship music! Tomorrow, Tues, 11/3, at 12:15 pm (meeting/lunch period) on the Chapel Lanai (Ewa side of the chapel). All faculty, staff, and students are welcome. God bless!

entries.title: Food4thought Acai-bowl Party
entries.text: It’s November, which means it’s time to kick off Food4Thought! Help us celebrate this K-12, ONE TEAM effort to fight hunger. The C+CE Student Leaders will have free acai bowls for all of you who come out to learn how you can get involved. See you this Wed, 11/4 at the Pā, during the mtg pd and lunch!

CELEBRATE "INTERNATIONAL RED HEAD DAY" Nov 5 by coming to opening night of the 'Iolani Dramatic Players' production of ANNIE! Last chance to secure your seats for ANNIE at MAMIYA THEATRE ON THE ST. LOUIS CAMPUS! (Not Hawaii Theatre!) Best availability is THURS, Nov 5th at 6pm. Some seats are still available for Friday, Nov 6th at 7pm. SATURDAY Nov 7th is SOLD OUT! All tickets are $10.00 each. Ticket Link: Annie Ticket Link

entries.title: Spring Musical Auditions
entries.text: 'Iolani Dramatic Players Announces Auditions for our Spring Musical at Hawaii Theatre: HADESTOWN. Auditions are Thurs and Fri Nov 12 and 13, 3:15-5:30. Performance Dates are Feb 18, 19, and 20, 2027. Rehearsals begin Mon, Nov 30, and run Monday-Friday from 3:15-5:30. No rehearsals over Winter Break. If you have any questions please contact: asakaguchi@iolani.org or mchicks@iolani.org Audition Registration Form Link: https://forms.gle/Kg3TL2Zc8h24htWW9 Audition Materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JrWtv2_umjiZY3qbBTUUSHVfWZ49Gsu7?usp=sharing

GRADUATION SUIT FITTING - FRIDAY 11/6 - SETO HALL - Please sign up for a 10- minute suit fitting appointment during your free period/lunch/after school here: Appointment Sign-Up Link. Slot times will become unavailable when filled (max 5 students per time slot). Email cco@iolani.org or come to College Counseling Office with any questions. Thank you!

BIG/LITTLE SIBLING KICKOFF! Hey Juniors and Seniors!! It’s time to kick off our Big/Little Sibling Program! Get ready to make some awesome memories! Start in Homeroom for attendance, then Juniors and Seniors head to the Lower Gym for our first Big/Little Sibling Meeting!

entries.title: Food4thought Club Meeting
entries.text: Join us for the mtg today, Mon, 11/2, lunch, I- 110. BYOL, and we will provide free snacks! We will be working on creating sustainability activities for Lower School students. We will also provide a sneak peek at some exciting new club events coming up in November. If you have any questions please feel free to email achristie@iolani.org.

entries.title: Future Business Leaders of America
entries.text: FBLA is excited to announce our upcoming school conference on Nov 24, with the award ceremony on Nov 25! Students can compete in a variety of events, with overall top scorers receiving a $50 gift card and finalists earning medals and certificates. ALL (you do not need to be in FBLA) interested students are encouraged to register and showcase their skills. Please register using this link by Nov 15: https://forms.gle/CzYHhN7MZPiWEwkw9 Please contact klp2801@iolani.org or ec2801@iolani.org for more information.
